target: decide which lever is real for the run-engine-vs-binary margin disagreement (SEA@NE 2026-09-09: run-engine derived ML 63.5% / ~4.5-pt fav vs binary Platt 78.0% / ~7.5-10.2-pt fav)
scope: READ-ONLY audit — no engine/pricing/feature/frontend change. Evidence = decided OOF rows only (1,376 games; slate/serve-time rows never used as calibration evidence). Harness: nfl-backend/backend/probe_margin_disagreement.py (pure reads over committed artifacts + the canonical feature cache). Record is tracked-only (the tracked-file guard protects it per the audit guardrail; it does not ride a protected prefix — the targeted retention-prefix fix covered nfl_run_engine_diagnostics_/nfl_markets_fit_panel_parity_ only).

a1_features.run_engine_per_side: SIDE_FEATURES = FEATURE_COLUMNS minus the is_home anchor = the 12-pool HOME-MINUS-AWAY DIFFS ONLY (elo_diff, win_pct_diff, rest_days_diff, is_dome_home, ewm_net_pts_diff, ewm_ypp_diff, pace_plays_min_diff, rest_short_diff, div_game, travel_miles_diff, altitude_home, prime_time). NO per-side levels, NO opponent-quality LEVEL input anywhere in the λ fit. The ONLY per-side level signal is the era center (ewm_2w, 14-day halflife) — fit targets are (score - center), the center is added back at predict (oof_centered_per_side / refit_centered_per_side).
a1_features.binary_served_set: nfl_moneyline_v1_*.json config.features = the SAME 12 diffs (is_home excluded as a model column, handled by a team-orientation mask; the '13-feature served set' counts FEATURE_COLUMNS including the is_home anchor, which neither model feeds as a column). Both models consume the SAME build_slate_features board for 2026 rows and the same decided-train-median imputation concept (binary: bundle impute_median; run engine: decided_f medians).
a1_features.structural_difference: run engine = per-side SCORE regressors + era center + pinned DN joint (σ 9.663/9.0789, ρ 0.0076, tie 0.275%) -> derived ML P(H>A)/(1-P_tie); binary = direct P(win) 5-member ensemble (XGB/LGB/Logit/RF/MLP + adaptive AUC blend) + pre-holdout-OOF Platt twin. The binary has NO era anchor and NO margin step.

a2_regularization.model: LightGBM regressor, objective mae, lr 0.05, num_leaves 31, min_child_samples 20, feature_fraction 0.8, bagging 0.8/5, early stopping 50 on the fold's own val, MAX_ROUNDS 2000; era walk median rounds HOME 20 / AWAY 23 (pinned in nfl_era_3e8c8a510f04.json).

sextile_response_oof.method: MLB 39c865e mirror — mean margin per sextile of each quality feature over the 1,376 OOF rows; recovery % = (predicted sextile-5-minus-0 spread) / (actual spread).
sextile_response_oof.finding: the run engine is STRUCTURALLY COMPRESSED toward the mean (recovers only 59-67% of the true quality-margin spread); the binary OVER-recovers (105-119%). Both extremes are wrong in opposite directions.

sea_at_ne_20260909.run_engine_row: fair_spread 5 (home SEA), fair_total 45, p_home_win_derived 0.6351, p_home_cover_0_5 0.6333; mu pair SEA 24.9 / NE 20.4 -> margin 4.5 (internally consistent: Phi(4.5/13.2)=0.6335).
sea_at_ne_20260909.era_centers: era_center_home 22.62 / era_center_away 21.56 — a 213-day ewm_2w decay (last decided game 2026-02-08) collapses every weight to ~1e-5; the ratio converges to the final-weeks scoring mean, so the centers sit near the league mean with a residual +1.06 home gap. The center contributes only ~1.06 of the 4.5-pt margin at season start.
sea_at_ne_20260909.served_features: elo_diff 110.49 (decided median 4.06 — ~27x), ewm_net_pts_diff 11.15, ewm_ypp_diff 0.233, win_pct_diff 0.0833, travel_miles_diff -2484.6, altitude_home 46, prime_time 1; imputed only where the board is NaN (pace 76.5%, is_dome 15.8%, travel/altitude 19.9% — decided-train medians, identical in concept for both models).
sea_at_ne_20260909.decomposition: margin 4.5 = center gap 1.06 + LGBM diff response ~3.44. The historical ACTUAL mean margin at the top elo sextile is +10.5 — the run engine prices this extreme-quality game at 43% of the realized level; the binary's 0.7805 implies ~10.2 under the pinned DN sigma.
sea_at_ne_20260909.anchoring_verdict: season-transition anchoring is REAL but not the root cause: at week 1 the centers carry ~1 pt instead of in-season level, AMPLIFYING the compression; the compression itself is measured in-season on the 1,376 OOF games (where centers carry real level) and persists.

a4_binary_comparison.same_inputs: same 12 diffs, same board features, same median-imputation concept, same serve-time NaN handling (both fill with train medians).
divergence_points: Platt-calibrated probability vs pinned-DN probability conversion
no era anchor in the binary
5-member blend response (105-119% over-recovery) vs 20/23-round LGBM response (59-67% under-recovery)

b5_shared_universe.not_in_oof_explained: the 16 are 2021-24 playoff games (weeks 19-22) — outside the 88-fold regular-season walk geometry; the shared universe is exactly the 1,376 regular-season pooled/sealed games.
b5_shared_universe.actuals: carried on every joined row (home_score/away_score from both artifacts; 4 final ties present and excluded from win-rate denominators via home_score > away_score)

b6_disagreement_distribution.key_finding: the models AGREE ON AVERAGE (mean gap ~0, identical mean margin) but diverge ±10.4 pts per game (70% of games >5 pts apart) — the SEA@NE case is a per-game divergence, not a systematic bias.

b6_concentration.finding: U-shaped in confidence (binary >> derived on extreme underdogs; binary < derived in the 40-60% middle; binary > derived at 60-80%; binary < derived at 80%+); NO road-favorite or totals-band asymmetry.

b7_calibration_by_actuals.key_finding: the binary DOES produce 78% on real decided history (n=191 in its 70-80% Platt band) and is MIS-CALIBRATED there: pred 0.7485 vs actual 0.6754 (ECE 0.073). The run engine's 63.5% sits in its WELL-CALIBRATED 60-70% band (pred 0.6465 vs actual 0.6701). The two bands' realized win rates nearly coincide (~67.0 vs ~67.5) — the truth at SEA@NE is ~67%, and the run engine is closer (63.5 vs 67) than the binary (78 vs 67). The binary RAW axis is well-calibrated at 70-80% (0.747 vs 0.800) — the overconfidence is introduced/aggravated by the Platt map at that band.

b8_gap_attribution.method: standardized OLS of (binary - derived) on the 12-pool, 1,376 rows
b8_gap_attribution.finding: the 12-pool explains ~35% of the per-game gap, dominated by elo_diff — the models diverge SYSTEMATICALLY where the quality level is extreme (both the run-engine compression and the binary over-recovery grow with quality).

b9_internal_card_wobble.numbers: same value 0.635096 displayed two ways on the SEA@NE card: the ML row renders _pct(dh, 1) -> '63.5%'; the run-line ±0.5 stop's per-side note renders _pct(v, 0) -> '(ML 64%)'. The 'wobble' is DISPLAY PRECISION ONLY — one decimal vs integer rounding of the identical p_home_win_derived value. No model inconsistency; both come from p_home_win_derived.

part_c_verdict.classification: MIXED — primary mechanisms (b) run-engine sigma-compression/shrinkage AND (d) binary overconfidence at high bands; (c) season-transition anchoring amplifies at week 1 but is not the root cause; (a) missing opposing-quality LEVEL is secondary on the run-engine side (the model under-moves on elo_diff it ALREADY has).

evidence_table.lever: (a) information asymmetry — run engine missing opposing-quality LEVEL
evidence_table.evidence: SIDE_FEATURES are 12 home-minus-away diffs only; no per-side/opponent level. BUT the sextile table shows under-movement on elo_diff/ewm_ypp_diff (features present), so the missing input is not the primary driver of the RESPONSE deficit.
evidence_table.verdict: secondary — relevant to the LEVEL/anchoring dimension, not the response dimension

evidence_table.evidence: run engine recovers 59-67% of the true quality-margin spread (sextile); gap regression R2 0.35 with elo_diff dominant; LGBM early-stopped at median 20/23 rounds; mirrors MLB 39c865e (margin model recovered ~37%).

2026-09-09 centers 22.62/21.56 (213-day decay -> near-league, residual +1.06 home gap); center contributes ~1 of the 4.5-pt margin at week 1; compression measured IN-SEASON on OOF persists with real centers.
evidence_table.verdict: amplifier at season start, not the root cause

evidence_table.evidence: Platt 70-80% band pred 0.7485 vs actual 0.6754 (ECE 0.073); SEA@NE 78% sits at the top of that band; binary implied margin over-recovers (105-119% of true spread); raw axis is fine at 70-80% (0.747 vs 0.800) — the Platt map aggravates it.
evidence_table.verdict: PRIMARY other-side mechanism — a binary calibration item, not a run-engine problem

recommendation.primary_lever: (a) NFL-P1 opposing-quality-LEVEL input arm — the ONLY lever with a successful MLB precedent (8cb4efc: opposing LEVELS with a real prior improved sealed margin CRPS; 39c865e/b7eed32: bare feature/view/regularization arms failed). Recommend the gated next spec with P1 semantics: per-side/opponent LEVEL inputs (e.g. elo/ewm level + opponent level) WITH a real prior, NOT a bare feature addition.
recommendation.complementary: (c) season-start prior/anchoring fix — cheap, small (center gap ~1 pt at week 1); a season-start prior on the era center would restore level carryover. Second arm if the P1 arm is built.
recommendation.flag_product_decision: (b) margin-level reconciliation with the binary is NOT recommended unilaterally — it trades run-engine independence (a product decision; the audit shows both models are wrong in opposite directions at the extremes, so reconciliation is not obviously toward truth).
recommendation.binary_side: (d) is a binary calibration item: the published Platt axis's 70-80% band overconfidence (ECE 0.073) should be tracked/re-calibrated on the binary side — out of run-engine scope, flagged here so it is not mis-attributed to the run engine.
recommendation.not_recommended: (d-as-in-no-change) no run-engine change is NOT supported — the 59-67% response compression is measured and structural.

part_c_verdict.step0_answer: the lever is REAL: the run engine is structurally compressed in its quality response (b), the binary is overconfident at high bands (d), and the week-1 anchor amplifies (c). The next gated spec should be the NFL-P1 opposing-quality-level arm (a) with a real prior, plus the season-start anchor fix (c) as a secondary arm; the binary's Platt 70-80 band is a separate calibration item.
